en: Oh, no, there's no need to thank me. I just thought that even you need a breather now and then, Angel.{wait}{clear}
There's no need to make such a face. Look, there's a firefly glowing on your shoulder, Angel.{wait}{clear}
Oh...{wait}{clear}
Hehehe... Let us relax tonight, Angel.{wait}{clear}
Yes, you're right... Let's do that.{wait}{clear}
Angel, do you feel refreshed?{wait}{clear}
Yes, thank you. But what about you? Instead of worrying about me, you should think about yourself...{wait}{clear}
No, I am fine. I was refreshed right alongside you, Angel.{wait}{clear}
Really? Well, if you say so.{wait}{clear}
Hehehe. Now, I shall do my best once again!{wait}{clear}
Thanks, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. I'll put it to use.
Thanks. I'll put it to use.
Thanks.
Thank you, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.
Thanks. You sure?
Thank you... ＄＄＄＄＄＄.
Thank you...
Ah... thanks.
Thanks, as always.
I'll put it to use...
Thank you...
For me? Thanks.
Thanks, I'll take it.
Sure, I'll take it.
Thank you, I'll treasure it.
Yeah, thanks.
Didn't you have anything a little better?
Thank you, I'll take good care of it.
Not bad at all. I'll take it.
Well, I'll take it.
...Well, it's free. I'll take it.
Pretty nice. I'll take it.
Thank you. I shall treasure it.
Huh, for me? Thanks, I'll put it to good use.
I'll put it to use. Thanks.
What's this?
Huh, for me? Thanks.
Thanks.
What is THIS?!
Thank you, I'll treasure it...
Thank you, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.
Thank you.
That's sweet of you.
How lovely, thank you.
Angel, thank you very much.
Thank you very much, Angel.
I'm sorry to trouble you, Angel.
Thank you very much.
I'm sorry...
Something else to talk about?
Your health?
Aren't you tired?
Are you worried about me? But if this little walking tired me out, I couldn't keep traveling...{wait}{clear}Maybe someone who's never traveled can't understand that.
Walk together
May I walk with you?
Sure, I don't mind.{wait}{clear}Well? It's nice to walk on your own two feet once in a while, isn't it?
Feel the wind
It feels nice to walk with the wind blowing, doesn't it?
It does...{wait}{clear}Moments like this might be what lets me breathe easy on the road...
Rough roads
Depending on where you go, there may be a lot of rough roads, which could be hard. Will you be all right?
I've been traveling all this time. That's nothing.{wait}{clear}If I only picked level roads, I'd never reach the places you ask me to go.{wait}{clear}Besides, rough roads are good training.
New places
Don't you ever get lost when you go somewhere new?
Hahaha! Do I look that unreliable? A Warlock who said that would never get any work done.
Blue sky

The sky is so beautiful when you look up at it from the ground. It feels completely different from what we see from above.{wait}{clear}We only ever look down from above, so it's hard for us to notice things like this.
I see... So that's how you see this world.{wait}{clear}I thought angels were beings high above, beyond our understanding, but that's not so, is it?
Lovely views
Arcaya has so many wonderful views, doesn't it?
Yeah, I think so too... But my favorite might be dusk on Bremes Isle...
Fairies useful?
Are the fairies a help to you?
Yes, they do good work. When they work that hard, it makes me feel I have to pull my own weight.
On the road
Don't you find yourself thinking and feeling all kinds of things when you travel?

Yes, I suppose so... I think about a lot of things...{wait}{clear}When you're walking, you have plenty of time. Though sometimes it feels like no matter how much I think, I just go around in circles...
People met
It's fun meeting people on the road, isn't it?
It is. When you meet people and talk, you hear all sorts of news. And that leads to something...
Sweet dreams
I hope you have sweet dreams.
Yeah... I hope so too...
Good work
Thank you for your hard work.
Aren't you the one who's tired? I'm going to get some rest now. You should head back and rest soon too.
Like sleeping?
Do you like sleeping?
You ask strange things, for an angel... Well, fine...{wait}{clear}I don't like or dislike sleep. I just make sure to sleep properly to keep my body in shape.
Events
I'm sure a lot has happened, but please get some good rest.
Yeah... A lot has happened, all right... There was plenty before you appeared to me, but it's nothing compared to now.
Bedtime habit?
Is there anything you do before bed, or any habit you have?
Let's see... I never skip caring for my sword. I need to be fully prepared for when it counts.
Strange places
Can you sleep well even in an unfamiliar place?
If that bothered me, I couldn't keep traveling. Besides, it's been a long time since I had a bed of my own...
Can't sleep?
What do you do when you can't sleep?
Let's see... I read a book, or go outside and relax...{wait}{clear}I could just keep traveling, but it'd be trouble to be off my game when it counts, so I try to take it easy and not push myself.
Your home
Traveling the world like this, don't you ever think about your home?
Yeah... But I don't remember much about my hometown...{wait}{clear}I traveled all through my childhood, and after that I lived on Bremes Isle.
Stay with you
Would you mind if I stayed with you a while?
I don't mind, but shouldn't you get some rest soon?
On waking
Is there anything you always do when you wake up?
Let's see, I always make a point of checking my belongings.{wait}{clear}Naturally when I sleep outdoors, but even at an inn I can't let my guard down completely.
Keep going?
Are you going to keep going?
Yeah, I've only just started.{wait}{clear}Even if I can use magic, a Warlock who lets his body go soft is no Warlock at all.
Thank you
Thank you for everything.
What's this? I don't think I've done anything to be thanked for...{wait}{clear}It's not as if I'm fighting just for you...
Hard training?
I imagine training can be hard at times...
Some training is hard and grueling, sure, but if all you do is complain, you won't learn a thing, will you?{wait}{clear}Well, I know you're saying it because you're worried about me.
No rest?
You've been training nonstop. Are you sure you don't need a rest?
Yeah, I'm just getting into the swing of it. It'd be a waste to stop now.{wait}{clear}I'll rest when I'm tired, so don't worry about it.
So dedicated
You seem to be training very hard.
Dedicated, huh... I suppose... When I train, I don't have to think about anything else.{wait}{clear}It's the only time I can focus on just one thing.
Your stamina?
Are you confident in your stamina?
Hahaha...! You angels sure worry about everything.{wait}{clear}I wouldn't be doing this if I weren't confident in my stamina.
Don't get hurt
Please be careful not to get hurt.
Yeah, I know... Getting hurt in training would be pointless, right?
What to watch
Is there anything you pay attention to when you train?
First and foremost, focus. Without focus, I think nothing you do will work.{wait}{clear}And the mental strength to sharpen that focus. For magic, that's a very important strength too.
How's it going?
How is your training going?
Same as always. I'm going at my own pace.
Results
It feels good when your training pays off and you see results, doesn't it?
Yeah, it does...{wait}{clear}Still, I never expected to hear that from an angel.{wait}{clear}Have you ever done anything like training yourself?
Am I a bother?
I came without warning... Am I bothering you?
No, I'm taking a break, so you're no bother.{wait}{clear}Could you not worry so much?
Favorite thing?
Is there anything you like to do?
An abrupt question, just like you.{wait}{clear}I've never really thought about it, but I like reading. I want to keep pursuing knowledge all my life.
Change of pace
Doing something different from usual makes for a nice change of pace, doesn't it?
